problem: The non-applicable-date branch can conform even when nltl:applicableIceClassRegulationEdition is nltl:iceClassRegulationEdition2002, because its SPARQL constraint checks only whether the dates meet the applicability condition and does not reject selection of the 2002 edition outside that condition.
required_change: In the non-applicable branch, require that nltl:applicableIceClassRegulationEdition is absent or is not nltl:iceClassRegulationEdition2002, while preserving the existing date-condition check.
regression_guard: Preserve rejection of the 2002 edition when the construction dates do not satisfy stage on or after 2003-09-01 and contract before 2010-01-01.

problem: The candidate never references nltl:iceClass, although the requirement declares iceClass as the required input and anchor variable.
required_change: Add nltl:iceClass as a required input to the target ship constraint, without inventing an additional ice-class value restriction.
regression_guard: Preserve the existing ship target and applicability logic while retaining the required iceClass input.
